items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: the bass line for this tune comes from Monk’s composition “Bemsha Swing.”

ctx.x: Well it’s a very catchy, enjoyable album.
Thank you. This particular tune is entitled “Tunk,” T-U-N-K. And the T-U is for the tuba and the N-K is for Monk because the bass line for this tune comes from Monk’s composition “Bemsha Swing.”
